Největší město Abruzza s letištěm, dlouh: The largest city of Abruzzo with an airport, a long beach and year-round amenities. The most expensive part of the region and at the same time the easiest to reach from the Czech Republic.
Jižní pobřeží provincie Chieti s rybářsk: The southern coast of the province of Chieti with fishing trabocchi, rocky coves and a cycle path along the former railway. Quieter and cheaper than around Pescara.
Horské obce, kamenné domy v historických: Mountain villages, stone houses in historic centers and the lowest prices in the region. For those looking for authentic Italy, not the beach.
